title: Restart a specific robot using the Robot Selection Restart screen (robot ID) and confirm the positioned robot display
summary: Use the Robot Selection Restart screen to enter/select a specific robot by robot ID, click “Restart,” ensure the robot is physically at the restart point or on the QR code cell, and then confirm the positioned robot is displayed on the screen.
when_to_use: When you need to restart a specific AGB/robot and you know which robot is at the restart point or on the QR code cell, and you must verify the restarted/positioned robot is shown on the Robot Selection Restart screen.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the restart via the Robot Selection Restart screen by entering/selecting the correct robot ID and clicking “Restart,” then verify the positioned robot appears on the screen.
safety_notes: Do not continue repeated restarts without confirming the robot is at the restart point or on the QR code cell.
access_or_tools_needed: Robot Selection Restart screen (HMI/UI shown in the training frame)
Robot ID (corresponding robot identifier to enter/select)

system_preconditions: The robot you intend to restart must be at the restart point or on the QR code cell (restart success is tied to this physical condition).
You must have the corresponding robot ID (or be able to select the robot) to enter/select on the Robot Selection Restart screen.

visual_references.description: Robot Selection Restart slide showing: enter/select robot ID, click “Restart,” restart tied to restart point/QR code cell, and “After starting, the robot that has been positioned will be displayed.”

steps.title: Open the Robot Selection Restart screen (Robot Selection Restart / Restart Robot)
steps.purpose: Access the UI controls needed to restart a specific robot by robot ID.
steps.instruction: Open the Robot Selection Restart screen (labeled “Robot Selection Restart” / “Restart Robot”).
steps.expected_result: The Robot Selection Restart screen is open and ready for robot ID entry/selection and “Restart” action.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the Robot Selection Restart screen elements for entering/selecting a robot and the “Restart” button.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot locate the Robot Selection Restart screen or the “Restart” button.

actions.label: Open Robot Selection Restart screen
actions.exact_action: Open the Robot Selection Restart screen (shown in the training frame as “Robot Selection Restart” / “Restart Robot”).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text on the slide shows: “Robot Selection Restart” / “Restart Robot” and the restart procedure steps.

steps.title: Enter/select the corresponding robot ID on the Robot Selection Restart screen
steps.purpose: Target the correct robot for restart.
steps.instruction: In the Robot Selection Restart screen, enter the corresponding robot ID or select the robot in the robot selection field.
steps.expected_result: The intended robot is selected/entered on the Robot Selection Restart screen (robot ID corresponds to the robot you will restart).
steps.healthy_condition: The robot selection field reflects the robot ID you intend to restart (or the robot is selected for restart).
steps.failure_condition: You enter/select the wrong robot ID (robot selection does not match the robot at the restart point/QR code cell).

actions.label: Enter/select robot ID
actions.exact_action: Enter the corresponding robot Id or select the robot.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text: “1. Enter the corresponding robot Id or select the robot.”

steps.title: Click the “Restart” button
steps.purpose: Initiate the restart for the selected robot.
steps.instruction: Click the “Restart” button on the Robot Selection Restart screen.
steps.expected_result: The restart action is initiated for the selected robot.
steps.healthy_condition: The “Restart” button is clicked for the selected robot (restart process begins).
steps.failure_condition: Restart is not initiated (e.g., no restart action occurs after clicking).

steps.title: Ensure the robot is at the restart point or on the QR code cell
steps.purpose: Make sure the physical condition required for restart success is met.
steps.instruction: Verify the robot you restarted is physically at the restart point or on the QR code cell.
steps.expected_result: The restarted robot is at the restart point or on the QR code cell (the physical condition required for restart).
steps.healthy_condition: Robot is positioned at the restart point/QR code cell location that matches the robot’s node code/cell code on the floor.
steps.failure_condition: The robot is not at the restart point/QR code cell when restart is initiated.

actions.label: Confirm physical restart position
actions.exact_action: Ensure the robot is at the restart point or on the QR code cell.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the positioned robot does not appear on the Robot Selection Restart screen after clicking Restart, stop and escalate for deeper troubleshooting (do not continue repeated restarts without confirming the robot is at the restart point/QR code cell).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text: “3. The robot will restart (it is at the restart point or on the QR code cell).”
Transcript: QR code has a physical number on it; node code/cell code matches what is on the floor for verifying location.

steps.title: Verify the positioned robot is displayed after starting
steps.purpose: Confirm the restart resulted in the correct robot being positioned and represented on the screen.
steps.instruction: After the restart starts, check the Robot Selection Restart screen to confirm the robot that has been positioned is displayed.
steps.expected_result: After starting, the screen displays the robot that has been positioned.
steps.healthy_condition: The positioned robot appears on the Robot Selection Restart screen after the restart begins.
steps.failure_condition: The positioned robot does not appear on the Robot Selection Restart screen after clicking Restart.

actions.label: Confirm positioned robot display
actions.exact_action: After starting, verify that the robot that has been positioned is displayed on the screen.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the positioned robot does not appear on the Robot Selection Restart screen after clicking Restart, stop and escalate for deeper troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text: “4. After starting, the robot that has been positioned will be displayed.”

success_criteria: After starting, the Robot Selection Restart screen displays the robot that has been positioned.
healthy_conditions: Robot restart is tied to the robot being at the restart point or on the QR code cell.
The positioned robot appears on the Robot Selection Restart screen after restart starts.
failure_conditions: The positioned robot does not appear on the Robot Selection Restart screen after clicking “Restart.”
The robot is not at the restart point or on the QR code cell when restart is initiated.
escalation_guidance: If the positioned robot does not appear on the Robot Selection Restart screen after clicking Restart, stop and escalate for deeper troubleshooting.
